items.en: Initially, when Kyler Murray suffered this heavy hit while trying to go down and avoid a tackle,
items.zh: 一开始，Kyler Murray 倒地躲避擒抱时遭到重击

items.en: the announcers thought he was grabbing for his knee
items.zh: 解说员还以为他在捂膝盖

items.en: But the reality is, this is a far more concerning injury displayed as a result of a head injury
items.zh: 但实际情况更令人担忧，这是头部受伤后的表现

items.en: Welcome back, everybody. I'm Dr. Brian Sutterer,

items.en: and the goal of the channel is to teach more about the medical side of the sports world
items.zh: 这个频道会带大家了解体育背后的医学知识

items.en: Early in today's week one game, Kyler Murray was trying to go down here and avoid this tackle
items.zh: 今天第一周的比赛刚开始，Kyler Murray 正准备倒地躲过擒抱

items.en: You're going to see the first impact come in from the Packers player striking the top of his helmet
items.zh: 第一次撞击来自 Packers 球员，他打到了头盔顶部

items.en: This could have contributed to some of the impact blow to the head that led to the concussion
items.zh: 这次撞击可能是导致脑震荡的一部分原因

items.en: but I think the bulk of it here was when the second player came in and struck him,
items.zh: 但我认为更主要的是第二名球员随后的撞击

items.en: when his head was already laterally bent off to the side
items.zh: 当时他的头已经向一侧弯曲

items.en: The announcers thought that he was grabbing at his knee,
items.zh: 解说员以为他是在捂膝盖

items.en: but really what we were seeing here is something we're likely to see again during the season: this fencing response
items.zh: 其实这是赛季中可能还会出现的“击剑反应”

items.en: You can see here how Kyler's arms are rigid. His fists are clenched
items.zh: 可以看到 Kyler 双臂僵直、双拳紧握

items.en: His right leg is held in some rigid posture, elevated off the ground,
items.zh: 他的右腿也僵硬地抬离地面

items.en: as he's unfortunately unconscious here because of a brain injury
items.zh: 此时他因脑部受伤已经失去意识

items.en: Right as this happened, the players are obviously very concerned
items.zh: 这一幕发生后，场上球员都非常担心

items.en: It looks like Murray's right arm is a little bit flexed, while his left arm is in more of an extended position
items.zh: Murray 的右臂略微弯曲，左臂则伸得更直

items.en: We'll talk about why we can often see that as well
items.zh: 稍后我会解释为什么会出现这种姿势

items.en: As the medical staff appropriately comes out to the field,
items.zh: 医疗人员随后及时进入场内

items.en: we see him finally start to regain a little bit of consciousness, but clearly struggle with his alertness
items.zh: 他开始恢复一点意识，但清醒程度明显仍然很差

items.en: There are still some seemingly involuntary firing of his muscles
items.zh: 他的肌肉仍有一些不自主收缩

items.en: We're still going to see some rigidity here in that right leg,
items.zh: 右腿也仍然保持僵硬

items.en: and some very clear loss of awareness and level of consciousness,
items.zh: 意识和对周围环境的感知明显受损

items.en: as they finally get him on his back to properly evaluate him
items.zh: 医疗人员最终让他仰卧，以便进行正确评估

items.en: This is a very classic example of a posturing response seen after a concussion,
items.zh: 这是脑震荡后非常典型的异常姿势反应

items.en: that's often called a fencing response
items.zh: 通常称为“击剑反应”

items.en: Players don't always exhibit the very classic fencing response,
items.zh: 球员并不一定都会呈现最典型的击剑姿势

items.en: which is going to be like one arm tucked, one arm out, this kind of en garde position
items.zh: 典型表现是一只手臂收起、另一只伸出，像击剑的预备姿势

items.en: But this is still a form of posturing
items.zh: 不过这仍属于异常姿势反应

items.en: The normal brain pathways regulate things that are activated and things that are inhibited
items.zh: 正常情况下，这些神经通路会调节哪些信号兴奋、哪些受到抑制

items.en: They become briefly impaired and sort of offline because of an injury to the brain
items.zh: 脑损伤会让这些通路短暂受损，暂时“掉线”

items.en: So this is an outward sign of an internal brain injury
items.zh: 所以它是内部脑损伤在外部的表现

items.en: And when we see this, this is clear as day: this is a concussion
items.zh: 一旦看到这种反应，几乎可以明确判断是脑震荡

items.en: You can watch this video; you don't need to go do a sideline concussion assessment
items.zh: 仅凭这段画面，就不必等场边脑震荡评估才能判断

items.en: You can say from this video and that posturing response that this was a concussion
items.zh: 从视频里的异常姿势就能判断，这是一次脑震荡

items.en: Next, we're going to dive into the neuroanatomy of why this fencing response happens,
items.zh: 接下来我们深入看看这种击剑反应背后的神经解剖学

items.en: and if there are any clues that it may tell us about how the impact occurred
items.zh: 以及它能否提示撞击是如何发生的

items.en: As we look at this cross-section of the human brain,
items.zh: 现在来看人脑的这张横截面图

items.en: there are essentially two directions of signals that control the position and movement of our limbs
items.zh: 控制四肢姿势和动作的信号，基本分为两个方向

items.en: You have signals coming from the brain down to the muscles,
items.zh: 一类信号从大脑向下传到肌肉

items.en: and signals coming from the body back up to the brain
items.zh: 另一类则从身体向上传回大脑

items.en: We call the signals going from the brain and spinal cord down to the body efferent signals, with an E
items.zh: 从大脑和脊髓传向身体的叫传出信号，英文以 E 开头

items.en: Afferent signals, with an A, come back up from the body as sensory inputs
items.zh: 从身体传回来的叫传入信号，英文以 A 开头，负责感觉输入

items.en: Deep within the brain, much of this happens through the brainstem and cerebellum
items.zh: 在大脑深部，这些处理很多都通过脑干和小脑完成

items.en: The brain regulates how signals coming up from the body influence the signals going back down,
items.zh: 大脑会调节身体上传的信号如何影响向下发出的指令

items.en: to make sure that everything is working synchronously
items.zh: 从而确保身体各部分协调运作

items.en: There are brakes built into this system
items.zh: 这套系统内部还设有“刹车”机制

items.en: When your cortex fires signals saying move, move, move,
items.zh: 当大脑皮层不断发出“动起来”的信号时

items.en: brakes within the brainstem suppress some of those signals
items.zh: 脑干里的“刹车”会抑制其中一部分信号

items.en: You may have heard of people who have Parkinson's disease
items.zh: 大家可能听说过帕金森病

items.en: Parkinson's involves a loss of inhibition of some nerve signals,
items.zh: 帕金森病涉及部分神经信号的抑制功能减弱

items.en: which is why people can have rigidity and spasticity
items.zh: 因此患者可能出现僵硬和痉挛

items.en: When a concussion impacts the brain, you deregulate those signals and affect the brakes in that system
items.zh: 脑震荡冲击大脑时，会扰乱这些信号，也会影响系统里的“刹车”

items.en: and get abnormal excitatory movements because of that loss of inhibition
items.zh: 失去抑制后，就可能出现异常的兴奋性动作

items.en: Normally, when you walk upright, your body makes your legs rigid to keep you up,
items.zh: 正常直立行走时，身体会让双腿保持张力来支撑你

items.en: while keeping your arms loose because they don't need to be rigid
items.zh: 手臂则会保持放松，因为不需要僵直

items.en: But if an infant is about to fall, the brain has a reflexive ability,
items.zh: 但婴儿快要跌倒时，大脑会触发一种反射

items.en: when it senses falling, to suddenly make the arms rigid to guard against the fall
items.zh: 一旦感到身体在下坠，双臂会突然伸直来保护身体

items.en: As we grow, the brain learns to suppress that urge to make the arm muscles rigid,
items.zh: 随着成长，大脑会逐渐学会抑制这种让手臂僵直的冲动

items.en: so we're not walking around with straight, rigid arms all the time
items.zh: 这样走路时，手臂就不会一直笔直僵硬

items.en: Before Murray gets knocked out, his brain is properly regulating the signals
items.zh: Murray 被撞昏前，大脑还能正常调节这些信号

items.en: deciding which muscles to activate, which not to activate, and which to relax
items.zh: 决定哪些肌肉发力、哪些不发力，以及哪些保持放松

items.en: But his head is first knocked by the arm, and then another player comes in,
items.zh: 但他的头先被手臂撞到，随后另一名球员又撞了上来

items.en: causing further lateral bending of the head off to the side
items.zh: 让他的头进一步向侧面弯曲

items.en: That causes mechanical stretch and strain in certain locations within the brain,
items.zh: 这会让大脑某些区域受到机械性牵拉和应变

items.en: specifically at the junction between the cortex and the brainstem
items.zh: 尤其是大脑皮层与脑干的交界处

items.en: temporarily disrupting the brakes on the system
items.zh: 从而暂时破坏这套系统的“刹车”

items.en: When those brakes are disrupted, the innate drive to fire and make the arms rigid returns
items.zh: “刹车”失效后，让手臂发力僵直的原始反射便重新出现

items.en: and that's what brings out the fencing response
items.zh: 这就形成了我们看到的击剑反应

items.en: It's a callback to a reflex called the asymmetric tonic neck reflex,
items.zh: 它类似于婴儿期的“不对称性紧张性颈反射”

items.en: from before the brain learns to regulate that internal handbrake
items.zh: 那时大脑还没学会控制这套内部“手刹”

items.en: As we see the rigid firing of his arms,
items.zh: 当他的手臂突然僵直发力时

items.en: there has been a short-term mechanical disruption of that brake in the brain
items.zh: 说明大脑里的“刹车”机制发生了短暂的机械性中断

items.en: so there's no inhibition on the brain's innate drive to fire the arms and make them rigid
items.zh: 原始的手臂发力反射失去抑制，于是双臂变得僵硬

items.en: He temporarily returns to a more primitive developmental state, so to speak,
items.zh: 可以说，他暂时回到了更原始的发育状态

items.en: before that brake is built in, when we reflexively fire and lock out the arms
items.zh: 也就是“刹车”尚未形成、手臂会反射性伸直锁住的阶段

items.en: The difference between this and an impact seizure, where the arms continue to move,
items.zh: 它和撞击性癫痫发作的区别在于，后者的手臂会持续运动

items.en: is that the fencing response only has what we call the tonic part
items.zh: 而击剑反应只有所谓的强直阶段

items.en: Tonic means rigid muscle tone
items.zh: “强直”指肌肉持续僵硬

items.en: An impact seizure combines tonic with clonic movements
items.zh: 撞击性癫痫则同时包含强直和阵挛

items.en: Clonic means the back-and-forth movements
items.zh: “阵挛”就是来回抽动

items.en: So a standard fencing response is purely tonic,
items.zh: 所以标准的击剑反应只有强直表现

items.en: just a locked arm position caused by the loss of the brainstem's brake
items.zh: 双臂锁住，是因为脑干的“刹车”暂时失效

items.en: Specifically, the lateral vestibular nucleus is the area involved
items.zh: 具体涉及的区域是外侧前庭核

items.en: We lose that brake and get rigid firing of the arms,
items.zh: “刹车”失效后，手臂就会僵直发力

items.en: but typically within seconds, the body resets and that brake comes back online
items.zh: 不过通常几秒内身体就会重置，“刹车”也会恢复

items.en: Then you're suddenly able to relax and move your arms again
items.zh: 随后双臂就能再次放松和活动

items.en: The fencing response doesn't tell us much about the severity of a concussion,
items.zh: 击剑反应并不能直接说明脑震荡有多严重

items.en: as much as it tells us where in the brain the neurons were disrupted
items.zh: 它更多是在提示大脑哪一部位的神经元受到了干扰

items.en: The brain isn't one single thing like a biceps muscle
items.zh: 大脑不像肱二头肌那样只是单一结构

items.en: It has multiple areas—the cortex, cerebellum and brainstem—all doing different things
items.zh: 它包含皮层、小脑、脑干等多个区域，各自承担不同功能

items.en: When we see a fencing response, we know which part of the brainstem suppressing those movements is involved
items.zh: 看到击剑反应，就能判断脑干中负责抑制动作的区域受到了影响

items.en: When that brake goes offline and leads to fencing posturing,
items.zh: 当这套“刹车”掉线并引发击剑姿势时

items.en: we know what part of the brain was affected, but not necessarily how severe recovery will be
items.zh: 我们能知道受影响的部位，却不能据此判断恢复会有多困难

items.en: It tells us what part of the brain was most affected and temporarily offline
items.zh: 它只说明大脑哪一部分受影响最大，并暂时失去功能

items.en: We do seem to get more fencing responses with lateral bending,
items.zh: 侧向弯曲时，击剑反应似乎更常见

items.en: So here that makes sense, more so than just the front head-on impacts
items.zh: 这次的情况也比单纯正面撞击更符合这一点

items.en: From a physiologic perspective, this junction between the cortex and brainstem
items.zh: 从生理角度看，皮层与脑干的交界处

items.en: seems to be affected more in these bending moments
items.zh: 在这种弯曲动作中似乎更容易受到影响

items.en: and we certainly saw that here with Murray
items.zh: Murray 这次显然就是如此

items.en: His head is laterally bent more toward the right shoulder as the hit comes in
items.zh: 撞击发生时，他的头明显向右肩方向侧弯

items.en: That puts more strain on the area of the brainstem involved,
items.zh: 这会让相关脑干区域承受更大的拉力

items.en: leading to the fencing response we see on the field
items.zh: 最终引发场上看到的击剑反应

items.en: It is possible that Murray enters concussion protocol, clears it and plays next week
items.zh: Murray 可能进入脑震荡观察程序，通过评估后下周复出

items.en: But given what we saw and recent changes in the NFL, he'll probably miss at least a week
items.zh: 但结合现场表现和 NFL 近期规则，他大概率至少缺席一周

items.en: It wouldn't surprise me to see him back in week three, assuming there are no prolonged symptoms
items.zh: 如果没有持续症状，他第三周回归也不会让我意外

items.en: Remember, you can still have neck injuries that come up after the fact
items.zh: 之后仍可能出现颈部损伤

items.en: so they'll continue to follow for possible cervical spine injuries, neck injuries, pinched nerves and related problems
items.zh: 因此还要继续排查颈椎损伤、神经受压等问题

items.en: This kind of hit can also stretch the nerves and cause something like a stinger
items.zh: 这种撞击也可能牵拉神经，引发类似“刺痛症”的症状

items.en: Those are all things to watch for with Murray going forward
items.zh: 这些都是接下来需要继续关注的情况

items.zh: 本期视频就到这里

items.zh: 也希望你能从中学到一些东西
